info.title: The running history's words: the keys of a plugin's history line

PLUGIN_HOSTD_HISTORY_KEYS.description: The keys of a line of the running-history file, in the order the daemon writes them (the grouping-planner design note, The history record): history <uri> <binary digest> <host class> key=value ..., after the header line '# plugin-hostd history/1'. The value of every key is a whole number or a decimal, never negative. A line with a key outside these words is kept as it is by every save and never read.

oneOf.title: first
oneOf.description: UTC seconds of the first window.

oneOf.title: last
oneOf.description: UTC seconds of the last window.

oneOf.title: windowsSolo
oneOf.description: Windows the plugin ran in a worker of its own.

oneOf.title: windowsGrouped
oneOf.description: Windows the plugin ran in a worker of two or more.

oneOf.title: cpuP95Solo
oneOf.description: Percent of one core, the worker's utime plus stime over a window, an estimate of the 95th percentile of the windows run alone.

oneOf.title: cpuMaxSolo
oneOf.description: Percent of one core, the largest window run alone.

oneOf.title: pssMbSolo
oneOf.description: MiB, the Pss of the worker's smaps_rollup, the largest window run alone.

oneOf.title: xrunWindowsSolo
oneOf.description: Windows run alone in which JACK counted at least one xrun.

oneOf.title: xrunWindowsGrouped
oneOf.description: Windows run in a group in which JACK counted at least one xrun.

oneOf.title: crashesSolo
oneOf.description: Worker deaths of a worker of its own that the daemon attributed to the plugin.

oneOf.title: crashesGrouped
oneOf.description: Worker deaths of a group that the daemon attributed to the plugin.

oneOf.title: restartsGrouped
oneOf.description: Worker deaths of a group the plugin was a member of and was not the culprit of.

oneOf.title: quarantines
oneOf.description: Times the supervisor quarantined the plugin.

oneOf.title: lastCrash
oneOf.description: UTC seconds of the last crash the plugin was blamed for alone.

oneOf.title: lastCrashGrouped
oneOf.description: UTC seconds of the last crash the plugin was blamed for in a group.
